<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
  <line x1="319" y1="20" x2="324" y2="20" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="319" y1="16" x2="324" y2="16" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="319" y1="12" x2="324" y2="12" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="337" cy="17" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="13" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="13" x2="343" y2="10" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="353" y="11" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="356" y="14" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <rect x="376" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="61" x2="35" y2="51" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="61" x2="35" y2="71" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="61" x2="43" y2="61" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="58" y="69" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Procesando tu viaje</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="94" x2="390" y2="94" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Cloud information icon -->
  <g>
    <path d="M142 207 C142 193 153 183 167 183 C174 168 190 159 207 163" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M207 163 C224 163 237 174 240 188 C253 188 263 197 263 210 C263 225 251 236 236 236 L159 236" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M159 236 C144 236 132 225 132 211 C132 204 136 197 142 192" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M198 187 L198 215 M198 224 L198 225" fill="none" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="281" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Estamos procesando tu selección</text>
  <text x="195" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Esto puede tardar unos segundos.</text>
  <text x="195" y="332" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">No cierres esta pantalla.</text>

  <!-- Travel information -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="365" width="342" height="1" fill="#D1D1D2"/>
    <text x="24" y="397" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Mientras esperamos</text>
    
    <rect x="23" y="416" width="344" height="74" rx="14" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="23" y="414" width="344" height="74" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="451" r="19" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <polygon points="53,438 57,448 68,448 59,455 62,466 53,459 44,466 47,455 38,448 49,448" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <text x="84" y="446" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Consejo de viaje</text>
    <text x="84" y="468" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Ten tus documentos listos para tu próximo vuelo.</text>

    <rect x="23" y="502" width="344" height="58" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="531" r="18" fill="#E0E0E2"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="531" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="531" x2="53" y2="526" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="531" x2="58" y2="534" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="84" y="527" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tu selección está segura</text>
    <text x="84" y="547" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Estamos verificando disponibilidad y tarifas.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Purple loading tray -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="590" width="390" height="254" rx="14" fill="#110053"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="634" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="72 42"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="610" x2="195" y2="603" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Cargando información</text>
    <text x="195" y="706" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Estamos buscando la mejor opción para ti.</text>
    <rect x="39" y="733" width="312" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="39" y="733" width="132" height="5" rx="3" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="775" x2="390" y2="775" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.28"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="38,801 49,792 60,801 60,813 53,813 53,805 45,805 45,813 38,813" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="49" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Inicio</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="122" cy="801" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="122" y1="792" x2="122" y2="810" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="113" y1="801" x2="131" y2="801" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="122" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Viajes</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="181" y="793" width="28" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="185" y1="798" x2="205" y2="798" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="186" y1="805" x2="193" y2="805" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="195" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Reservas</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="273" cy="798" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="273" cy="811" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="273" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Cuenta</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <line x1="334" y1="794" x2="356" y2="794" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="334" y1="801" x2="356" y2="801" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="334" y1="808" x2="356" y2="808" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="345" y="831" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Menú</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
